gloss_en: Heel (singular) — the anatomical heel of the foot (Hebrew ʿaqev), the lowest bodily extremity; homiletically linked to feet/רגלין (Torah 22, reading Deut 7:12 'ekev tishme'un' as heel) and to Yaakov as the lowly one (דל, Torah 177); distinct from the plural עקבים and from עֵקֶב in its plain biblical sense of 'consequence/because'
